skill_name: List three of the most influential leaders of the 20th century.
workflow: The three most influential leaders of the 20th century include Mohandas Gandhi, Nelson Mandela and Martin Luther King Jr. Each of them had a powerful impact on their respective societies during the century and continue their legacies even today. Gandhi successfully led the Indian Independence Movement, leading to the decolonization of India from British domination. Mandela was instrumental in dismantling the South African Apartheid government and changing the social landscape of the nation. Mart
